description:
Finds online stores that Faceabot checked for AI shopping agents: not blocked, agent checkout available (UCP), and whether the price agents read matched the store (price truth record).
Use when: you shop for a user and need a store for a product or brand.
Do not use when: you need a software tool (use solve_need).
Example: {"query":"running shoes","agent_checkout_only":true}

agent_checkout_only.description: true = only stores declaring agent checkout (UCP)

query.description: Product, brand or store words, e.g. perfume, running shoes

name: find_shop
title: Where to buy: stores verified for shopping agents
